# cloudsigma_jobs (Data Source)

Reads the CloudSigma asynchronous Jobs collection as dynamic JSON. Jobs are read-only and may include recursive child jobs.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identity for the current Jobs collection.
- `json` (String) The complete Jobs collection as canonical JSON.
